text:
elaine: Quick docs PR heads-up — I'm opening a PR that crosswalks quota tiers -> metering windows and adds an SDK snippet demonstrating per-call headers for burst credits. Need a quick review from eng + metrics. Example: `X-Redwood-Quota: tier=pro;burst=20` — does that header shape look right?

mike: that header looks fine. please add usage example showing token math for embeddings vs gen :thumbsup:

darya: pinging eng-metrics — we need to confirm the dashboard panel names. the current doc references "Quota Usage (per-route)" which doesn't exist anymore, should be "Quota Consumption — routes".

samir: re dashboards — is the new daily-rate metric normalized to requests or tokens? if tokens we should show conversion formula.

elaine: tokens. i'll add a small calc block. sample:
```
# convert requests to tokens
avg_tokens_per_request = 512
monthly_tokens = requests * avg_tokens_per_request
```

emily: l10n note: keep string short for translations, avoid inline code in headings. also request i18n tag in PR.

kevin: found a broken link in the docs sidebar -> /docs/metering/tiers links to old slug. i can push a tiny redirect fix in the PR.

docs-bot: PR: #4387 opened by @elaine — docs/pr/quota-metering-crosswalk — reviewers: @mike @darya @samir

mike: I'll review tomorrow morning and add an SDK snippet for python/js. For python: `client.headers.update({'X-Redwood-Quota': 'tier=pro;burst=20'})`

elaine: thanks! also adding a short "how to read the dashboard" micro-guide with screenshot link (uploaded to PR). please call out where to toggle "normalized tokens".

samir: ok — will confirm metric normalization and provide a mapping table from metric -> panel id. I'll paste panel ids in a followup message here.

darya: after samir's mapping we should add a quick "migration" note for customers who used the old `per-route` panel. small checklist: update dashboard link, verify alerts, update SDK header examples.

emily: approved for content once kevin's redirect and samir's metric check are in. :rocket:

elaine: awesome — aiming to merge EOD Friday if reviewers sign off. tagging @product-ops for awareness.
